Privacy Policy

This policy explains what personal data the Teceze ESS Portal mobile application (Android package com.teceze.essportal) collects from you as an employee user, why we collect it, and the choices available to you. It is written to be read by the people it's about, not just by lawyers.

In plain terms

The four things worth knowing before you read the rest

Location, only at the moment you check in or out. We read a single GPS position to confirm attendance per company policy — we never track your location in the background or at any other time.
No ads, no analytics, no trackers. The app contains no advertising SDK, analytics SDK, or crash-reporting SDK of any kind.
One recipient. Your data is sent only to Teceze's own HR system (erp.teceze.com) — never sold, and never shared with outside advertisers.
You're an employee, not a "user." This app exists to run your employer's HR processes — attendance, leave, timesheets — so most of what it collects is what any HR system needs.

01

Scope & who we are

The Teceze ESS Portal ("the App", "ESS Portal") is an internal Employee Self-Service application built and operated by Teceze ("Teceze", "we", "us", "our") for use by our own employees. The mobile App connects to our HR system at erp.teceze.com to provide attendance tracking, leave management, timesheets, payslip access, and internal approvals. The same account and HR data are also accessible through our web application, hosted at pottu.ai — both are the same underlying system and this policy applies equally to your data regardless of which one you use.

This policy applies to any employee who signs in to the App with their Teceze HR credentials. It does not apply to any other Teceze product or to any third-party website you may reach through a link inside the App.

Because this is an internal workforce tool rather than a consumer product, Teceze acts as both the operator of the App and the employer processing your HR data — there is no separate "vendor" relationship to disclose here.

03

What we don't collect

We think what an app doesn't do deserves the same clarity as what it does. The ESS Portal does not, at present:

  • Track your location in the background. Location is read only once, at the instant you check in or out — the App has no background-location permission and cannot access your location at any other time, including while closed.
  • Run any advertising, analytics, or crash-reporting SDK. There is no ad network, no usage-analytics vendor, and no third-party crash reporter integrated into the App.
  • Sell or rent your data. We have never sold personal data to a third party and never will.
  • Access your contacts, calendar, or files beyond the single photo or document you deliberately choose to attach via the picker described above.

If we add biometric app-unlock (Face ID / Touch ID) in a future release, that verification happens entirely on your device through your phone's own operating system — your fingerprint or face data is never transmitted to or stored on our servers.

04

How we use your information

We use the information above strictly to run the HR functions the App provides:

  • Recording and reporting your attendance and worked hours
  • Processing leave applications and attendance-regularization requests, and routing them to the correct approver
  • Maintaining accurate employment and contact records
  • Delivering timesheet data for project and billing purposes
  • Sending you real-time updates about your own requests (approved, rejected) and company announcements (holidays, birthdays)
  • Keeping your account secure and preventing unauthorized access
  • Meeting our statutory record-keeping obligations as an employer

We do not use your data for advertising, do not build behavioral profiles from it, and do not use it for any purpose unrelated to your employment.

06

How we share your information

Your information stays within Teceze. Specifically:

  • HR and IT personnel who administer the ERP system, on a need-to-know basis
  • Your reporting manager and designated approvers, limited to what they need to review and act on your requests
  • Payroll processing — if and when salary data is processed through this App, it will only be shared with Teceze's designated internal payroll function, under the same confidentiality obligations as the rest of this policy

We do not share your personal data with advertisers, data brokers, or any other third party for their own marketing purposes. We may disclose information if required to do so by law, regulation, legal process, or a governmental request, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Teceze, our employees, or the public.

If Teceze is ever involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, employee data covered by this policy may be transferred as part of that transaction, subject to the same protections described here.

07

Storage, retention & security

All traffic between the App and our servers is encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS). Your sign-in session is stored on your device using your operating system's encrypted secure storage (Android Keystore / iOS Keychain), not in plain text.

We retain your HR data for as long as your employment continues, and afterward for the period required by applicable labor, tax, and financial-record-keeping law, after which it is deleted or anonymized in line with our internal retention schedule.

No system is completely immune to risk, but we apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards — access controls, encrypted transport, and encrypted local session storage — appropriate to the sensitivity of workforce data.

09

After your employment ends

When you leave Teceze, your App access is deactivated. Your HR records are retained for the statutory period described in Section 7 for legal, tax, and reference-check purposes, then deleted or anonymized. Signing out of the App only clears your local session on that device — it does not delete any server-side record, which follows the retention schedule above regardless.

10

Children's privacy

The App is a workplace tool intended solely for use by Teceze employees of employable age. It is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under the minimum legal working age in their jurisdiction.

11

International transfers

Where your data is processed or stored in a country other than the one you work in, we take steps to ensure it continues to receive a comparable level of protection to that described in this policy, consistent with applicable data protection law.

12

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes in the App's features or in applicable law. The "Effective" date at the top of this page always reflects the latest version. Material changes will be communicated to you through the App or via internal company channels.

13
